_README.purpose: burn-level grouping units for FireMan-UAV-RGBT; filled by agent from frame content (thermal overlays, scene/light/season consistency, DINOv2 similarity). Only burn C is metadata-confirmed. Authors (contacts in README) should be asked for the per-video location/date list before any training use.
_README.split_policy: unit = burn; A->train (native-res sunny bog), B->quarantine (Ruokolahti candidate; Boreal ruokolahti is a historical final-test site), C->holdout (GPS-confirmed independent burn), D->val. Frames duplicating existing eval material would inherit that role (none found).
